long_biography.plain_text:
Semenov built his career in Russian business-aviation infrastructure. As general director of Avia Group, he oversaw construction and launch of Terminal A at Sheremetyevo, a dedicated complex for private-aircraft passengers, hangarage and ground handling. He also led Avia Group Nord, which developed related services at Pulkovo in St Petersburg.

Under his management, the companies expanded support for flight planning, maintenance coordination, aircraft storage and helicopter operations. Semenov also served on the board of insurer SOGAZ through his Avia Group role. He later returned to A-Group as chief executive, continuing a career centred on the development and management of airport services for business aviation.
